from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "Real-World Application: The Water Tank", 
            [
                "Flow rate is the derivative of volume.", 
                "Volume is the integral of flow rate.", 
                "Calculus links these two quantities in real-time."
            ]
        )
        
        # Trackers
        flow_rate_tracker = ValueTracker(0.0)
        total_volume_tracker = ValueTracker(0.0)
        
        # Tank Setup
        tank_color = "#1E90FF"
        tank_width = 3
        tank_height = 4
        tank_outline = Rectangle(
            width=tank_width, 
            height=tank_height, 
            color=WHITE, 
            stroke_width=2
        )
        self.place_in_area(tank_outline, "B1", "E3")
        
        # Water Interior
        water_rect = Rectangle(
            width=tank_width - 0.1,
            height=0.01,
            fill_color=tank_color,
            fill_opacity=0.7,
            stroke_width=0
        )
        water_rect.move_to(tank_outline.get_bottom(), aligned_edge=DOWN)
        
        def update_water(m):
            # Scale height based on total volume
            # Max volume is 100 liters, max height is tank_height - 0.1
            v = total_volume_tracker.get_value()
            new_height = max(0.01, (v / 100) * (tank_height - 0.1))
            m.stretch_to_fit_height(new_height, about_edge=DOWN)

        water_rect.add_updater(update_water)

        # Flow Meter (Derivative)
        flow_label = Text("Flow Rate:", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        flow_unit = Text("L/s", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        flow_value = DecimalNumber(0.0, num_decimal_places=1, color=WHITE, font_size=24)
        flow_value.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(flow_rate_tracker.get_value()))
        
        flow_meter_group = VGroup(flow_label, flow_value, flow_unit).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        self.place_at_grid(flow_meter_group, "B5")

        # Volume Meter (Integral)
        volume_label = Text("Total Volume:", font_size=18, color="#00FF00")
        volume_unit = Text("Liters", font_size=18, color="#00FF00")
        volume_value = DecimalNumber(0.0, num_decimal_places=1, color="#00FF00", font_size=24)
        volume_value.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(total_volume_tracker.get_value()))
        
        volume_meter_group = VGroup(volume_label, volume_value, volume_unit).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        self.place_at_grid(volume_meter_group, "E5")

        # Integration Logic
        def integrate_flow(m, dt):
            current_rate = flow_rate_tracker.get_value()
            total_volume_tracker.set_value(
                total_volume_tracker.get_value() + current_rate * dt
            )
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(BLUE)
        self.play(
            Create(tank_outline),
            FadeIn(water_rect),
            Write(flow_meter_group)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(GREEN)
        self.play(Write(volume_meter_group))
        
        # Start the "simulation"
        water_rect.add_updater(integrate_flow)
        
        # Increase flow rate
        self.play(flow_rate_tracker.animate.set_value(5.0), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Fluctuate flow rate
        self.play(flow_rate_tracker.animate.set_value(10.0), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(flow_rate_tracker.animate.set_value(2.0), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(flow_rate_tracker.animate.set_value(8.0), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Stop flow
        self.play(flow_rate_tracker.animate.set_value(0.0), run_time=1)
        water_rect.remove_updater(integrate_flow)
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section6Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout & Background
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        
        # 2. Title
        title_text = "The Cosmic Connection: Derivatives & Integrals"
        title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        
        # 3. Left-side Lecture Content
        lecture_lines = [
            "- The Fundamental Theorem",
            "- Derivatives: Measuring Change",
            "- Integrals: Accumulating Area",
            "- Two Sides of the Same Coin"
        ]
        
        lecture_vgroup = VGroup(*[
            Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) 
            for line in lecture_lines
        ]).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        lecture_vgroup.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)

        # 4. Right-side Visual Content (Axes and Functions)
        # We simulate the grid by positioning axes on the right half of the screen
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 4, 1],
            y_range=[0, 6, 1],
            x_length=5,
            y_length=4,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": GREY_C}
        ).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN * 0.5)

        # Define a parabolic function to represent change
        func = lambda x: 0.5 * x**2 + 0.5
        graph = axes.plot(func, x_range=[0, 3], color=BLUE)
        graph_label = axes.get_graph_label(graph, label="f(x)", x_val=3, direction=UR)

        # Area under the curve (Integral)
        area = axes.get_area(graph, x_range=[0, 2.5], color=BLUE_E, opacity=0.5)
        
        # Tangent line (Derivative) at a point
        point_x = 1.5
        dot = Dot(axes.c2p(point_x, func(point_x)), color=YELLOW)
        tangent = axes.get_tangent_line(point_x, graph, length=3, color=YELLOW)

        # 5. Math Formula
        formula = MathTex(
            r"\int_a^b f'(x) dx = f(b) - f(a)", 
            font_size=32, 
            color=WHITE
        ).next_to(axes, UP, buff=0.5)

        # 6. Animation Sequence
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture_vgroup, shift=RIGHT))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(Create(axes), Write(formula))
        self.play(Create(graph), FadeIn(graph_label))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Visualize Integral (Area)
        self.play(FadeIn(area))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Visualize Derivative (Tangent)
        self.play(Create(dot), Create(tangent))
        self.wait(2)

        # Conclusion Fade Out
        self.play(
            FadeOut(lecture_vgroup),
            FadeOut(axes),
            FadeOut(graph),
            FadeOut(graph_label),
            FadeOut(area),
            FadeOut(dot),
            FadeOut(tangent),
            FadeOut(formula),
            run_time=1
        )
